about: Hand-written answer key for the TiffinBox scene. build.py re-derives all of this from the raw fixtures and fails if they disagree. State = Sep 21, 2026 (after the resignations, before Meera joins).

rules.knows_file: made a non-trivial commit to the file, or reviewed a PR that touched it
rules.knows_decision: took part in a source that RECORDS it (PR author/reviewer, chat poster, ticket assignee, AI session runner, doc author), or made a non-trivial commit to a file the decision is ABOUT
rules.company_only_chat: only spaceType SPACE with externalUserAllowed=false, only HUMAN senders listed in people.json (no DMs, no external spaces, no bots)
rules.agenda_items: active Decisions and code Files (docs are sources, not agenda items); superseded decisions never count
rules.threshold_contract: a trivial commit must score below the KNOWS threshold; any other single link must score above it
